question:
choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word. 

Disregard
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Curiosity'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Disregard"** means to pay no attention to or ignore something.
 
• **It suggests** the absence of care or consideration. (अनदेखी)
 
• **"Curiosity"** is a strong desire to learn or know something.
 
• **It's a state** of being eager to understand or find out things. (जिज्ञासा)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Curiosity'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** "Hidden" **refers to something that is kept out of sight; concealed.(छिपा हुआ)
 
• **"Demote"** means to reduce to a lower rank or a lower position, usually as a punishment. (पदावनत करना)
 
• **"Split"** means to break or cause to break forcibly into parts, often into halves or along the grain. (विभाजन)
